How to play The Rhyme Game

One word. Infinite rhymes. Until someone chokes. One player says a word, and everyone else must say a rhyming word — no repeats allowed. When someone can't rhyme or repeats, they're out.

2–10 players~7 minFast & CompetitiveWord games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. One player calls out a word to rhyme with.
  2. Going around, each player must say a word that rhymes — no repeats.
  3. If you can't think of one or repeat an answer, you're out.
  4. The last player standing picks the next word.
  5. Nonsense words are allowed if you can use them in a sentence.

Example round

  • Word: 'night' — 'right', 'bite', 'light', 'kite', 'flight', 'tight'...
  • Word: 'orange' — chaos ensues immediately.
  • Someone says 'bite' twice — eliminated.
  • Someone hesitates for more than 5 seconds — eliminated.

Tips

  • Pick rare words to knock people out fast: 'silver', 'purple', 'month'.
  • To keep it moving, set a 3-second time limit per answer.
